children: Blockaid has warned that StepDrainer attacks previously targeting Kintsu and Flap are expanding to StonkFun, Pickle Finance, Echelon, Origami, Fluxbeam, Stakepoint, SupSwap, Longbow, SHPRD and ApeX DeFi. According to Odaily, Pons founder Ozzy said in a post on X that Blockaid advises users to avoid the listed websites and previously identified affected decentralized applications, and not to connect their wallets.

title: StepDrainer Attacks Expand to More DeFi Projects as Blockaid Advises Users Against Connecting Wallets
